catalog_name: ALVI Cognitive Learning Path & Practice Catalog
disclaimer: These practice activities are experimental cognitive stimulation exercises designed to practice memory, sequencing, attention, and verbal descriptive skills. They are NOT medical treatment, cognitive rehabilitation therapy, or clinically validated to prevent or reverse dementia.

exercises.skill_practiced: Episodic Story Memory & Information Unit Recall
exercises.instructions: Listen to the short narrative about Aarav's morning walk, then retell the story verbally or in text, recalling as many core anchor details (people, locations, actions, objects) as possible.
exercises.explanation_template: Story Recall achieved {score}% completeness ({recalled_count} of {total_count} core anchors). Practicing narrative retell strengthens episodic retrieval and detail retention.

exercises.instructions: Arrange the narrative milestone cards into their exact chronological order from first event to last event to rebuild sequence coherence.
exercises.explanation_template: MindPlay detected event sequence transpositions. Chronological reordering exercises reinforce temporal working memory and executive planning.

exercises.instructions: Identify the target items mentioned in the narrative from a grid of cards while ignoring plausible semantic lure distractors.
exercises.explanation_template: Dual feature binding score was {ch1_score}/2 targets. Practicing paired object identification strengthens associative working memory against distractor interference.

exercises.instructions: Locate and select the target contextual item under live reaction timing while suppressing distractor alternatives.
exercises.explanation_template: Visual search reaction latency was {latency_ms} ms. Rapid target discrimination drills encourage focused visual scanning and prompt motor selection.

exercises.instructions: View the park scene prompt and describe what is happening in continuous, unhurried sentences, naming people, actions, and objects naturally.
exercises.explanation_template: Speech sample exhibited elevated low-energy pause intervals ({pause_percent}% pause proxy). Relaxed picture description practice promotes continuous vocal pacing without time pressure.

exercises.skill_practiced: Integrated Speech, Episodic Memory & Executive Cognition
exercises.instructions: Complete all three connected assessment steps (Voice Check-in, Story Recall, and MindPlay) to update your longitudinal cognitive baseline.
exercises.explanation_template: Regular multi-modal check-ins enable reliable intra-individual trajectory tracking and personal baseline maintenance.
